description: Intent i008 (snapshot s03, drm-userif-divisor) complete. Three high-confidence variants of the vega10 8*speed wrapped-zero divisor found, all reached from the unprivileged sysfs hwmon fan1_target store (amdgpu_pm.c:2836 amdgpu_hwmon_set_fan1_target -> kstrtou32 with no bound -> amdgpu_dpm_set_fan_speed_rpm -> smu_set_fan_speed_rpm/pp_dpm_set_fan_speed_rpm, each rejecting only U32_MAX): (1) drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c:1217 smu_v11_0_set_fan_speed_rpm guards only speed==0 then computes tach_period = 60 * crystal_clock_freq * 10000 / (8 * speed) in u32; registered for Navi10/Navi14 and Sienna Cichlid (navi10_ppt.c:3589, sienna_cichlid_ppt.c:3199). (2) drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/vega20_thermal.c:204 vega20_fan_ctrl_set_fan_speed_rpm, only !speed guard, no RPM-range check at all. (3) drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/arcturus_ppt.c:1270 arcturus_set_fan_speed_rpm with NO validation on speed (worse than seed: speed==0 also divides by zero). For speed = 2^29, 2^30, or 3*2^29 the u32 product 8*speed wraps to exactly 0 (verified by compiled C model showing 8u*536870912u==0 etc. and a raw SIGFPE), causing a kernel divide-by-zero oops during tach-period PM programming (local DoS). The seed site itself (vega10_thermal.c:320) is also unfixed in s03, and smu_v13_0.c:1229 carries the exact upstream fix (!speed || speed > UINT_MAX/8), confirming the missing guard in the other ASIC variants is an oversight. radeon si/ci_dpm.c contain the same expression but are static with no user-reachable exposure (radeon hwmon exposes only temp/pwm/freq attrs) - classified safe. smu7_thermal.c:280 and legacy-dpm/si_dpm.c:6722 depend on VBIOS u8 RPM-limit tables and are left unresolved for the firmware-table intent (i016). Limitations: findings are source-read + compiled-model verified, not hardware-confirmed; reachability needs dpm enabled and AMD_FAN_CTRL_MANUAL fan mode; nouveau/i915/xe and non-fan DRM user interfaces only spot-checked. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i008.json with snapshots_checked ["s03"], 3 findings, 8 classified candidates.
